headline: Gazipur building fire brought under control after 2.5 hours
summary: A fire erupted in a seven-storey building in Gazipur's Board Bazar area early this morning. Firefighters battled the blaze for nearly two hours before bringing it under control.
details: A fire broke out on the third floor of a seven-storey building located along the Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway in Gazipur's Board Bazar area today. The blaze started around 5:50 AM and was brought under control by 8:30 AM.
Five fire service units were dispatched to the scene and engaged in firefighting operations. The building houses several establishments, including a branch of Premier Bank on the third floor.

No casualties have been reported in the incident. Firefighters are continuing efforts to completely douse any remaining flames. The cause of the fire and the extent of the damage are yet to be determined and will be assessed after an investigation.

headline: 10 workers injured in Chattogram salt factory fire, several critical
summary: A fire broke out at a salt factory in Boalkhali upazila of Chattogram, injuring 10 workers. Several victims are in critical condition and have been admitted to Chattogram Medical College Hospital.
details: At least 10 workers sustained burn injuries after a fire erupted at the Confidence Salt Factory in Boalkhali upazila of Chattogram. The incident occurred around 10:30 am today.
All injured workers were immediately admitted to the burn unit of Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH). Several of the victims are reported to be in critical condition.
According to the hospital's police outpost Sub-Inspector Md Alauddin, the fire is suspected to have been triggered by an electrical short circuit, based on initial accounts from the workers.
caption:

According to the hospital's police outpost Sub-Inspector Md Alauddin, the fire is suspected to have been triggered by an electrical short circuit, based on initial accounts from the workers.
